tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Neural Cosmology: answers to questions about consciousness, cosmology, physics and biology; essays; interactive experiments; books and their chapters. Returns titles, URLs and markdown URLs to pass to read.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read any page of the site as markdown: an answer, essay, experiment, book page or chapter. Paid chapters give their open opening and how to buy the book.

tools.name: list_books
tools.description: The books, their languages, chapters (free, open opening, or paid) and prices of online access in each currency.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Open a checkout for online access to a book (or the whole library) for a reader, tied to their email. Returns a payment link to give to the reader; nothing is charged until they pay. After paying, the reader signs in on the site with that email and the book is theirs.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, create_checkout · Public sink: create_checkout.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, create_checkout · Public sink: create_checkout

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
